mapper.insert: insert into branch_events(branch_id, complainant, complainant_phone, complainant_type, complain_time, description, handler, handler_phone, status, customer_name, create_time,superiors_name, superiors_phone) values (#{branchId}, #{complainant}, #{complainantPhone}, #{complainantType}, #{complainTime}, #{description}, #{handler}, #{handlerPhone}, #{status}, #{customerName}, #{createTime},#{superiorsName},#{superiorsPhone})
mapper.update: UPDATE branch_events set complainant = #{complainant}, complainant_phone = #{complainantPhone}, complainant_type = #{complainantType}, complain_time = #{complainTime}, description = #{description}, handler = #{handler}, handler_phone = #{handlerPhone}, update_time = #{updateTime}, status = #{status}, branch_id = #{branchId}, superiors_name= #{superiorsName}, superiors_phone = #{superiorsPhone} WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: select customer_name, customer_address, belong_grid_code, belong_grid_name, service_type, bank_agency_name from performance_customer_info where customer_name = #{customerName}

select id, branch_id, complainant, complainant_phone, complainant_type, complain_time, description, handler, handler_phone, status, customer_name, create_time, superiors_name, superiors_phone from branch_events where customer_name = #{customerName} order by create_time desc limit 1

select id, branch_id, complainant, complainant_phone, complainant_type, complain_time, description, handler, handler_phone, status, customer_name, create_time, superiors_name, superiors_phone from branch_events where customer_name = #{customerName} order by complain_time

select b.duty_network_name, b.duty_network_code from anchor_point a left join grid_message_info b on a.anchor_name = b.duty_network_name where b.duty_network_name is not null and b.duty_network_name != '' and a.anchor_name = #{anchorName};

SELECT distinct p.customer_name, p.customer_address, s.bank_agency_name, s.duty_name, s.duty_phone, s.duty_telephone, p.belong_grid_name as gridName, g.grid_main_manager_name as gridMainManagerName, g.grid_main_manager_phone as gridMainManagerPhone, s.dot_introduce, g.rural_grid_type, p.anchor_ranks FROM performance_customer_info p LEFT JOIN grid_message_info g ON p.belong_grid_code = g.grid_code LEFT JOIN sys_dept s on p.customer_name = s.dept_name WHERE p.customer_name = #{customerName}
select id, branch_id, complainant, complainant_phone, complainant_type, complain_time, description, handler, handler_phone, status, customer_name, update_time from branch_events where id = #{id}
SELECT parent_code FROM pa_addr_info_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT name FROM pa_addr_info_type WHERE code = #{code}
